text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day—I went on the first shrine 
visit of the year with Gran Alegria to 
swear by our Senior-year goals.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This year, I will definitely conquer all 
three divisions!
choice_data_list:
I'll guide Gran safely to conquering all 
three classes!

text_block_list.text:
There is no longer any hesitation. 
Together, the two made a single vow!

On the way back, I stopped by a cafe with 
Gran Alegria for a break.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, they're showing last year's races. I 
wonder if mine is in there too?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? Looks like they're broadcasting a 
press conference."

Interrupting the race replay footage, a 
live broadcast suddenly began. Taking the 
stage was—

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here despite 
your busy schedules. I arranged this 
meeting because there is something I wish 
to convey to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Which means, is this an announcement for 
taking on overseas races!?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No. That is something to consider later 
based on the Umamusume's condition. This 
time, it is a matter concerning myself.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—I will be retiring as a Trainer at the 
end of this year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"T-That is so sudden... May I ask what led 
to your decision to retire?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What do you mean by 
'preparations'...?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Besides... the next generation will carry 
on my ambition. I knew I could leave it in 
their hands with peace of mind."

Afterward, following several questions 
looking back on the master's career, the 
press conference drew to a close...

It was completely out of the blue. To 
think that Master was considering 
retirement...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Our graduation is probably one of the 
reasons, surely.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: They trusted us to handle it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I'm supposed to be proud. How 
strange...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...80 miles, I'm so lonely...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so you were watching the 
broadcast. Well, that's how it is."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What will happen to the Umamusume that 
Master was in charge of?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm transferring to another Trainer. 
Everything's finalized on where I'm going, 
so it's being announced today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I see. What a relief!

I received so much from him. In a sense, I 
was the final disciple taught by the 
master...

As someone carrying on those teachings, 
what I want to cherish most of all is—
choice_data_list: Train Gran with a large group

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're... taking care of me?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Never push an Umamusume beyond her 
limits. You've put that into practice 
wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I want you to watch over me closely and 
help me grow from now on, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's true. You always think things 
through like that for me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm always at 100-mile energy! Ehehe♪

Let's continue to cherish Gran Alegria's 
reserve strength going forward.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Training with a large group... Ah, a joint 
training session with other Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That will improve efficiency as 
well. Oh, and between Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It would be wise to have them check each 
other for any abnormalities. That should 
help prevent danger.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Not only will you get stronger, 
but your safety level goes up by 3 miles 
too♪

I shall continue to provide Gran Alegria 
with well-rounded learning opportunities 
from here on.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're giving a present to me?!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. If what I need isn't at 
Tracen Academy, I'll just prepare it 
myself.”

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
In reality, there will be hardships... but 
it's best to carry that kind of 
determination with you.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"That preparation is precisely what 
expands the range of your running. 
...Though I mustn't give you any 
unnecessary rewards, of course."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... For a second, I thought you were 
going to give me something I liked!

If it broadens my future possibilities, 
I'll find a way to manage on my own. I 
want to make sure I never lose that 
mindset.
And after parting ways with my master—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's sad to see you retire, but... at 
least that's a relief. It seems the 
Umamusume under your master have already 
decided on where they'll transfer next.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it feels lonely. Thinking back, 
around Master, there was always..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It was always so comfortable there! All 
the Umamusume laughing together...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It felt like that had an impact on her 
race results as well.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I really hope teams like that can stick 
together forever.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You don't want to lose it either, right?! 
A place just like Master's team!

A mentor who will eventually depart. Yet 
even after she leaves, those feelings she 
wishes to leave behind...

――A one-year grace period. Until then, 
let's do everything we possibly can.
